scientific_integrity: Analytical all-parameter proof plus standalone small-domain exhaustive and randomized checks; finite tests are not substitutes for the proof. No independent scientific validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: One house per agent, arbitrary weak orders with at most k tiers; unallocated houses allowed. No claim for multiple goods per agent. A known Hall-violator framework is used; sharp tier-budget invariant is the contribution. Unindexed priority risk persists.
title: Sharp house-supply threshold for envy-freeness with bounded indifference tiers
